name: random_page_cost
description: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a non-sequentially-fetched disk page.
symptoms: planner chooses sequential scan over index scan
slow query performance on large tables
tuning_tips: The default of 4.0 is based on HDD random access speed. For SSDs or NVMe, reduce this to 1.1 or 1.0 to encourage the planner to use Index Scans more often.
official_snippet: Reducing this value relative to seq_page_cost will cause the system to prefer index scans; raising it will make index scans look more expensive.
